name: one-prompt
description: ONE PROMPT – an animated short film about learning AI, built with Remotion, plus a YouTube upload script.

scripts.preview: npm run assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts OnePrompt out/one-prompt.mp4 --codec=h264
scripts.thumbnail: npm run assets && remotion still src/index.ts Thumbnail out/thumbnail.png
